# Original FCL fixture

ventilation.fcl is original MIT-licensed project data, not a vendor export. It
represents the two active rules of the original FIS ventilation fixture; the FIS
fixture's extra zero-weight rule does not affect outputs. At [.5,.75] with four
output intervals, the expected trapezoidal centroid is 235/44. Nine endpoint and
overlap cases also compare memberships, activations and outputs against recorded
scikit-fuzzy data for the equivalent FIS model. This is numerical evidence, not
execution or certification of an external FCL parser. See doc/fcl.en.md.

## Direct external FCL execution

jfuzzylogic-reference.json records 36 original model/input cases generated by the
real jFuzzyLogic parser/runtime, using pinned commit
1f421d1b176b39cd7d08fa8f4d712d733abf1116 and archive SHA-256
7a30a415f48be4c679c25871e03507a475dddaccfdd5a9d3d46695171cc488a0.
No upstream source or binaries are distributed in this repository; the original
MIT test adapter builds the external LGPL dependency temporarily. The JSON stores
both native COG and the explicit trapezoidal conversion. This is original fixture
output data, not a claim that native quadrature or all DEFAULT cases match.

72 original/exported evaluations passed; max mapped difference 9.769962616701378e-14.
The native raw difference reaches 11 in the deliberately endpoint-only example:
the Java grid omits max and uses DEFAULT=-1, while the Dart grid returns 10.
Eight comparisons demonstrate this sampling-related DEFAULT difference. See
[the guide](../../../doc/fcl.en.md) for the exact sum conversion and reproduction.
